post.summary: Log out — ends the session (idempotent)
post.description: Kills the Keycloak session so the refresh token dies immediately; the access token already in the browser is NOT revoked and expires on its own within the realm's short lifespan (~2 min). scope="all" ends every device session. Re-calling is safe. The frontend must clear its own tokens regardless of the response.

Terminate a contract (step 1 of 2, OTP-gated)
post.description: Validates the contract is terminable (SCHEDULED/ACTIVE/PAUSED) and sends an OTP to the calling admin. Writes nothing; confirm via POST /api/v1/otp/verify (purpose CONTRACT_TERMINATE), which flips ACTIVE/PAUSED → TERMINATED (SCHEDULED → CANCELLED) and frees the contract's inventory. Optional reason.

post.summary: Extend a contract in place (step 1 of 2, OTP-gated)
post.description: Moves the contract's end date out (newEndDate required); the same contract is extended in place — no successor contract is created. commercialMode must be omitted (400 MODE_LOCKED_ON_EXTEND). Sends an OTP; confirm via POST /api/v1/otp/verify (purpose CONTRACT_EXTEND).

post.summary: Cancel a contract extension / shorten (step 1 of 2, OTP-gated)
post.description: Pulls the contract's end back before the chosen extension (periodId from GET .../rate-periods; e_0, the original term, is rejected — terminate instead), freeing that inventory and cancelling its billing segments. A future extension is removed whole (with every later one); an already-running one is cut to today. Sends an OTP; confirm via POST /api/v1/otp/verify (purpose CONTRACT_EXTENSION_CANCEL), which returns the refreshed rate periods.

post.summary: Amend a contract's rate/plan (step 1 of 2, OTP-gated)
post.description: Reprices a targeted rate period (optional periodId from GET .../rate-periods; omit → current period). At least one of ratePerDevicePreGst/imageSlotRate/videoSlotRate/subscriptionPlan is required (else 400 AMEND_EMPTY). Sends an OTP; confirm via POST /api/v1/otp/verify (purpose CLIENT_CONTRACT_AMEND).

post.summary: Initiate OTP-gated activation of an AD_PARTNER contract's inventory
post.description: OTP-gated, ADOPS-only. Until a contract is activated its slot leases stay DRAFT, the availability picker returns nothing for it and no campaign can be booked against it. Sends an OTP to the caller admin and mutates nothing; confirm via POST /api/v1/otp/verify (purpose CONTRACT_ACTIVATE). No request body. One-shot — a second attempt returns 409.

post.summary: Create a new client and client user
post.description: Creates a new client and an associated platform user. Accessible by ADOPS_ADMIN role.

post.summary: Take one contract back from an Advertising Partner (step 1 of 2)
post.description: Ad-ops only, no body. Sends an OTP; verify with POST /api/v1/otp/verify, purpose RESALE_CONTRACT_END: the contract ends today. Nothing is cancelled or refunded, and campaigns already booked on it play on. Its other contracts and the Media Partner's sharing are untouched. Allowed whatever the client's status. A contract that is not this Advertising Partner's resale contract is 404 CONTRACT_NOT_FOUND; one no longer live is 422 CONTRACT_STATUS_NOT_ALLOWED.

post.summary: Give shared contracts of linked Media Partners to an Advertising Partner (step 1 of 2)
post.description: Up to 10 contracts (configurable), across Media Partners, under one OTP. Checks every contract (open for resale, ACTIVE or SCHEDULED), both clients, their resale link, the days and that the Advertising Partner holds none of them yet; the first refused contract refuses the whole request. An Advertising Partner with no platform fee in force is 422 RESELLER_PLATFORM_FEE_REQUIRED. Then sends an OTP to the caller; writes nothing. Verify with POST /api/v1/otp/verify (purpose RESELLER_ASSIGN): every contract is written ACTIVE and billing is given each one's rate; if billing refuses one, none is kept.

post.summary: Start setting an Advertising Partner's platform fee
post.description: Sends an OTP to the caller; this response carries only the OTP handle. Verify with POST /api/v1/otp/verify (purpose PLATFORM_FEE_SET): the new % applies from that moment.

post.summary: Start turning ShareGrid on or off for a Media Partner
post.description: Body {enabled, reason}: enabled true turns it on, false turns it off. reason is required when turning off and optional when turning on (up to 500 characters); stored either way. Sends an OTP to the caller; verify with purpose SHAREGRID_SWITCH, which answers the Settings view. Already in the requested state is 422 SHAREGRID_ALREADY_ON / SHAREGRID_ALREADY_OFF, before any OTP is sent.

post.summary: Stop a contract's resale while the contract stays live (step 1 of 2)
post.description: Checks the contract (the Media Partner's own, its sharing live), then sends an OTP to the caller; writes nothing. Verify with POST /api/v1/otp/verify (purpose SHAREGRID_STOP): every live resale contract on it ends today and the sharing is terminated. Nothing is cancelled or refunded. The answer is the contract as the shared list shows it.

post.summary: Change a live sharing's resale rates (step 1 of 2)
post.description: Checks the contract (the Media Partner's own, its sharing live) and the new rates exactly as enable does (none below its floor), then sends an OTP to the caller; writes nothing. While the Media Partner's ShareGrid is off it is 422 SHAREGRID_OFF, before any OTP and again at verify. Verify with POST /api/v1/otp/verify (purpose SHAREGRID_RESALE_RATE_CHANGE): the rates are stored and every live resale contract is billed at them from today. Confirmed campaigns keep their price.

post.summary: Open a Media Partner's contract for resale (step 1 of 2)
post.description: Checks the contract, the days and every section's resale rate (monthly per slot, not below that section's floor), then sends an OTP to the caller; writes nothing. Verify with POST /api/v1/otp/verify (purpose SHAREGRID_ENABLE): the rates are written, sharing turns on, and the answer is the contract as the shared list shows it.

post.summary: Start removing a link
post.description: Sends an OTP to the caller; verify with purpose CLIENT_LINK_REVOKE. The row is kept as REVOKED. Allowed whatever the clients' status.

post.summary: Remove a reseller from a Media Partner — HARD stop (step 1 of 2, D75)
post.description: Ad-ops only. Beside the soft removal (client-links/{linkId}/revoke), this one also terminates the reseller's live contracts on this Media Partner today, so their campaigns stop. Sends an OTP; verify with POST /api/v1/otp/verify, purpose RESELLER_HARD_REMOVE: the contracts are terminated and the link removed in one step. Nothing is refunded automatically. Allowed whatever the clients' status. A link that is not this Media Partner's is 404; one already removed is 422.

post.summary: Start linking an Advertising Partner to a Media Partner
post.description: Always sends an OTP to the caller; this response carries only the OTP handle. Verify with POST /api/v1/otp/verify (purpose CLIENT_LINK_CREATE): on verify, a pair that was already linked comes back unchanged with alreadyLinked=true.

post.summary: Start suspending a client (OTP step 1 of 2)
post.description: Suspend stops the client's campaigns — existing ads drop off screens on the next manifest rebuild and no new campaign can be created or launched. Non-campaign operations (contracts, wallet, members, stores, creatives) continue and login is unaffected. Reversible via reactivate; nothing is cancelled. Sends an OTP to the caller admin; confirm via POST /api/v1/otp/verify. Legal from ACTIVE or FROZEN.

post.summary: Start reactivating a client (OTP step 1 of 2)
post.description: Returns a FROZEN or SUSPENDED client to ACTIVE. Sends an OTP to the caller admin; confirm via POST /api/v1/otp/verify. Cannot recover a PERMANENT_BLOCK client.

post.summary: Start permanently blocking a client (OTP step 1 of 2)
post.description: IRREVERSIBLE soft-delete. The row is preserved and blocked_on stamped, but the cascade cancels active leases, bookings and slots, deactivates allocations and frees inventory. The client's users can no longer log in — generate-otp refuses to send the OTP and returns 403 CLIENT_BLOCKED. Sends an OTP to the caller admin; confirm via POST /api/v1/otp/verify. Legal from ACTIVE, FROZEN or SUSPENDED; PERMANENT_BLOCK is terminal.

post.summary: Upload URL for a payout's bank receipt
post.description: Step 1 of 3. Only for a payout of this client that is still due. PUT the file to uploadUrl with every header in headers, then send its fileId to mark-paid/initiate.

post.summary: Start marking a payout paid
post.description: Step 2 of 3. Checks the payout and its uploaded receipt, then sends an OTP to the caller. Verify with POST /api/v1/otp/verify (purpose PAYOUT_MARK_PAID): the payout is then PAID.

post.summary: Start deleting a member for good
post.description: Sends an OTP to the caller. On verify the member's wallet is emptied, then in one transaction their brands move to transferToUserId, every access they hold ends and the user goes REMOVED: their number and email are free, and the same number added later is a new user. With no successor, 409 BRAND_ASSIGNMENTS_EXIST (no OTP sent) while a brand would be left with no campaign manager; data lists those brands. Remove member (revoke/initiate) on the client the member belongs to does this same delete; this route also takes a reason.

post.summary: Get an upload URL for a client's logo
post.description: Step 1 of 3. PUT the file to uploadUrl, then save it with PUT /api/v1/clients/{clientId}/logo.

post.summary: Start freezing a client (OTP step 1 of 2)
post.description: Freeze blocks ONLY new campaign creation; existing campaigns keep playing and every non-campaign operation (contracts, wallet, members, stores, creatives, rate-cards) continues. Login is unaffected. Sends an OTP to the caller admin — NOTHING is written here. Confirm via POST /api/v1/otp/verify (purpose CLIENT_STATUS_CHANGE) to apply it. Legal only from ACTIVE.

post.summary: Get an upload URL for a client's display image
post.description: Step 1 of 3. PUT the file to uploadUrl, then save it with PUT /api/v1/clients/{clientId}/display-image.

post.summary: Start setting a client's bill payment terms
post.description: Media Partner or Advertising Partner only. Sends an OTP to the caller; this response carries only the OTP handle. Verify with POST /api/v1/otp/verify (purpose BILL_PAYMENT_TERMS_SET). Months already closed keep their due dates.

post.summary: Start deleting a client admin for good
post.description: Sends an OTP to the caller. On verify the admin goes REMOVED: their number and email are free, and the same number added later is a new user. Only a bench or former admin can be deleted; the live admin is refused with ADMIN_IS_LIVE until a swap replaces them, so the client is never left without an admin.

post.summary: Start swapping the live client admin
post.description: Sends an OTP to the caller. On verify the incumbent is retired and the target promoted in one transaction, so the client is never left without an admin.

post.summary: Start creating a client admin
post.description: Sends an OTP to the caller. Nothing is written until it is verified. The new admin is created INACTIVE — a bench contact that cannot log in until a swap promotes them.

post.summary: Start reassigning a client's account manager
post.description: Sends an OTP to the caller. On verify the outgoing manager's grant is revoked and the incoming one written in one transaction, so the client is never left without one.

post.summary: Start a save of the AP→Brand rate-card grid: sends an OTP to the caller and writes nothing. POST /api/v1/otp/verify with the returned otpReferenceId saves the grid.

Revenue is recognised in FULL in each campaign's start month (not pro-rated) and counts SCHEDULED, LIVE, COMPLETED and CANCELLED — cancelled included because no refund is issued. The AP revenue breakdown above uses the same rule, so the two reconcile. revenueTrendPct is null when the previous month had no revenue (trendDirection=NEW).

get.description: statusCounts always carries every CampaignStatus plus ALL, computed across ALL the manager's campaigns — NOT the filtered page — so selecting a tab does not zero the others. screens is TRI-STATE: absent = the campaign has no device-selection rows at all (a DRAFT before devices are picked, or one whose selections a slot change invalidated), 0 = rows exist summing to zero. progressPct is absent for DRAFT and CANCELLED — render no progress bar for those.

Day-part occupancy — how full is a client's inventory, per day-part
get.description:
Plays the client can sell vs plays already filled (each slot × how often it plays at its screen's loop: 180 per 3h day-part at 60s; the fields keep their *Slots* names), for the window and for each day-part (MORNING 10-13, AFTERNOON 13-16, EVENING 16-19, NIGHT 19-22 IST), with image, video and combined percentages.

Defaults: no dates → today (IST); endDate alone → today..endDate; startDate alone → that one day; deviceTier absent → both tiers. Elapsed day-parts of today count in full.

ADVISORY: read from CDC replicas which lag (computedAt); availability-search remains the booking authority.

totalAllocated.description: Budget that arrived — allocations plus anything inherited from a departing colleague. Gross.

totalSpent.description: Campaign spend, NET of refunds — the ex-GST base the wallet paid; GST is not deducted from a wallet. Refunded money is back in the wallet, so it is not charged as spend. Can be negative when from/to splits a debit from its refund.

totalRefunded.description: Campaign money returned, gross. Kept on its own line so a campaign that ran and was undone stays visible.

RevokePrecheckResponse.description: Whether removing a member requires naming a successor, and for which brands

transferRequired.description: true when at least one brand would be left with no campaign manager

orphaningBrands.description: ONLY the brands that would lose their last campaign manager — not the member's full brand list

ContractListRow.description: Contract row with batch + sections + adPartnersOnBatch per V2 master sheet ADOps #24.

modelType.description: RENTAL_MODEL | REVENUE_SHARING. Exactly one rate is populated per model: REVENUE_SHARING -> slotRate, RENTAL_MODEL -> deviceRentalRate.

BillPaymentTermsResponseDto.description: When a client's bills are due

clientId.description: Client id

dueDays.description: Days after the month ends that its bills are due

realDueExtraDays.description: Days added to each bill's due date to give its read-only real due date: the client's own, else the default

isDefault.description: True while the client has no terms of its own and is on NET_30

isRealDueExtraDaysDefault.description: True while the client has no real-due extra days of its own and is on the default

ClientAdminListResponse.description: Paginated list of a client's admins.

ClientAdminResponseDTO.description: A user attached to a client — either via an access grant or by being one of its admins.

creationSource.description: ONBOARDING renders the "Added during onboarding" badge.

deactivatedReason.description: Why this admin was retired. Null unless a swap retired them.

deactivatedAt.description: When the swap retired them, epoch millis. Null when never retired.

lastLoginEpochMs.description: Last login, epoch millis. Null when this admin has never logged in.

isPrimary.description: True for the client's one live admin — the PRIMARY badge.

AccountManagerListResponse.description: The account managers currently on a client.

AccountManagerSummary.description: One account manager currently on the client.

role.description: PlatformRole name — ACCOUNT_MANAGER for every row this endpoint returns.

email.description: Null when the manager has no email on record — it is optional on a user.

mobile.description: Manager's mobile, so an ad partner can reach the person handling its account.

hasNext.description: Whether there is a next page

hasPrevious.description: Whether there is a previous page

campaignsCount.description: Number of campaigns associated with this brand

totalBudget.description: Total budget allocated to this brand

clientId.description: Client ID (brand)

imageSlotRate.description: Image slot rate PER SLOT PER MONTH for this daypart — the same unit the create/update request carries, so what was sent is what comes back

videoSlotRate.description: Video slot rate PER SLOT PER MONTH for this daypart — the same unit the create/update request carries, so what was sent is what comes back

imageCpm.description: CPM for one image slot. TARGETED only — send INSTEAD of imageSlotRate.

videoCpm.description: CPM for one video slot. TARGETED only.

rateCardType.description: Which delivery mode this row prices

ClientLinksResponse.description: Every active link, newest first, with both clients and who linked them.

ManagedClientResponse.description: A client an account manager looks after.

clientId.description: Client id

code.description: Client short code; null when the client has none

RemoveAccountManagerPrecheckResponse.description: What removing an account manager would leave behind.

transferRequired.description: True when some client has no other active account manager — the removal must then name a successor

managedClients.description: Every client the account manager holds

clientsLeftWithoutAccountManager.description: The clients no other active account manager holds — the ones that need a successor
